$comment: SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH for the working product brand. The product name is NOT legally finalized — domain + trademark checks are still required before public launch. To rename the product, edit productName here and run: node scripts/apply-brand.mjs --from "ServiceMomentum" --to "NewName"  (see docs/BRAND.md). The lowercase slug and uppercase wordmark are derived and rewritten by the same command. The symbol (productMark) carries no letters, so a rename never touches it.

productMark.status: PROVISIONAL — approved as a working symbol only. It stays provisional until the ServiceMomentum name clears trademark and domain checks; final adoption, any registration, and any external use wait on that clearance.
productMark.concept: An asymmetric four-stage open loop: an organic, varying-radius pathway that carries all four stages on it — the path starts inside stage 1 and ends inside the endpoint stage — and never closes.
productMark.lettersFreeNote: The symbol carries no letterforms — it does not depend on S, M, or any other initial — so renaming the product never touches the artwork.
productMark.rules: Drawn geometry only. No gradients, shadows, glow, arrows, houses, tools, AI motifs, or raster art — and the product wordmark is never baked into the artwork; it stays HTML text in .brand-name. The pathway is a spline, not a circular arc, so the mark does not read as a loading or status ring.

productTagline: From first search to next service.
positioningStatement: Turn your website and past customers into a repeatable growth system.
supportingStatement: We build local-service websites connected to lead tracking, review generation, customer management, and recurring-service follow-up.
endpointConfigNote: The lead-form endpoint is NOT mirrored here. js/site-config.js is the single source of truth for formEndpoint and formEndpointMode — two copies drifted once and will again. scripts/validate.mjs fails if this file reintroduces an endpoint field.
brandStatus: WORKING NAME — not legally finalized. Domain availability and trademark clearance for the product name are still required before any public launch or product-domain purchase.

theme.$comment: Approved FORGE palette. Mirrored as --forge-* custom properties at the top of styles.css, which is the single source of truth for the site. Change both together.
theme.retired: Service Navy and Momentum Amber are retired. scripts/validate.mjs holds the exact retired values in scripts/brand-lib.mjs and fails if any of them return to a shipped file.
